semantic_adjudication.reason: NL3 ('when power on, the system turn into human driving mode') requires the root-level initial edge into HumanDrivingMode to be an effective, unconditional entry. The exact model has transition:line:19 ([*] -> HumanDrivingMode, trigger Power_On), but inspection_equivalent_facts marks reachable_from_initial=false with diagnostic INITIAL_ENTRY_CONDITIONAL, verify_facts refutes initial-entry:transition:line:19 because it carries a trigger on what should be an unconditional pseudostate edge, and reference_inspection_facts raises W_INITIAL_UNCONDITIONAL_MISSING citing HumanDrivingMode as the expected first child. These exact deterministic facts establish that the root scope's dispatch to HumanDrivingMode is not a reliable unconditional entry as NL3 demands, because it competes with a second conditional root edge (Power_Off to FinalState) with no unconditional fallback. The alternative narrower reading -- that mere structural presence of the correctly-targeted edge suffices -- is a competent but weaker property (bare endpoint match) that does not resolve the exact reachability/unconditional defect the contract targets, so it survives only as an undercutting alternative reading, not as a rebuttal that defeats the violation.

semantic_adjudication.violated_obligation: NL3 requires an unconditional, effectively reachable initial pseudostate edge from root scope into HumanDrivingMode gated only by Power_On.

The exact model has transition:line:19 ([*] -> HumanDrivingMode, trigger Power_On), but inspection_equivalent_facts marks reachable_from_initial=false with diagnostic INITIAL_ENTRY_CONDITIONAL, verify_facts refutes initial-entry:transition:line:19 because it carries a trigger on what should be an unconditional pseudostate edge, and reference_inspection_facts raises W_INITIAL_UNCONDITIONAL_MISSING citing HumanDrivingMode as the expected first child. These exact deterministic facts establish that the root scope's dispatch to HumanDrivingMode is not a reliable unconditional entry as NL3 demands, because it competes with a second conditional root edge (Power_Off to FinalState) with no unconditional fallback. The alternative narrower reading -- that mere structural presence of the correctly-targeted edge suffices -- is a competent but weaker property (bare endpoint match) that does not resolve the exact reachability/unconditional defect the contract targets, so it survives only as an undercutting alternative reading, not as a rebuttal that defeats the violation.
